cost: Free courses available (others RM30 to RM1,750)

title: PERKESO reskilling for workers who lost their job (MYFutureJobs)
note: Workers insured under the Employment Insurance System (EIS) who lose their job can apply for upskilling and reskilling programmes, career counselling and job matching through MYFutureJobs. Confirm your eligibility with your advisor or PERKESO.

title: Rakyat Digital Literacy Hub
note: The government's free digital literacy courses: online banking and e-wallets, spotting scams and false news, staying safe on social media, and AI basics including generative AI and AI safety. A good first step before the job courses if you are new to digital tools.
